messages:
nora: Quick idea  a micro-launch for an OSS 'plugin gallery' refapp to drive contributor signals and demo leads. Short webinar + tutorial.
kevin: Nice. Targets: 400 repo stars, 90 registrants, 15 qualified leads.
tess: Tutorial plan: 3 hands-on labs: clone & run, swap model variant, add a plugin hook. Each <20m. Include a perf script.
amanda: I'll own blog + landing + 3 social GIFs. Also a 3-email cadence.
kevin: For benchmarks, two quick bullets: chat latency (local q4 vs hosted) and embeddings throughput. I'll produce a one-slide chart.
nora: Webinar: 30m hands-on + 15m Q&A. Proposed Wed Jun 2 11am PT. @tess can you run the infra demo?
tess: Yep. I'll demo a graceful fallback and a small quantized variant switch.
bot-campaigns: campaign created: plugin-gallery-launch, landing draft: https://redwood.example/plugin-gallery (owner: nora)
amanda: Lead form: checkbox for "Interested in dedicated trial" and hidden utm for tracking.
nora: Action items: nora->blog + landing (Tue), amanda->assets+emails (Wed), kevin->benchmark slide+perf script (Wed), tess->webinar ops+dry run (Thu). Dry run scheduled Mon May 31 9am PT. Keep updates in thread.
